subject: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jen Park <jen.park@heliomed.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff

Hi Jen & Samir —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. HelioMed is ready to move from POC to an initial production tenant; the aim is to have basic access and API keys provisioned so their engineering team can hit the /v1/generate endpoints in a sandbox project this week.

Monica (CSM) and Rishi (Solutions Eng) — looping you both in to do the implementation handoff and run the tenant/setup checklist. Proposed immediate deliverables: 
- Create HelioMed tenant (prod-sandbox-helio) and an initial project called "integration-test"
- Provision two API keys (one for engineering, one for ingestion jobs) and attach key notes (scopes/expiration)
- Create three user accounts with roles: Admin (Jen), Developer (Samir), Viewer (QA lead TBD)
- Confirm SSO plan: HelioMed prefers SAML 2.0; they have Azure AD.

Jen/Samir: can you confirm an engineer (name/email) who will accept the invites and a preferred time for the setup call? Monica, I attached an onboarding checklist and SSO notes to this thread.

Next steps: Monica to schedule the initial setup call; Rishi to prepare the minimal IAM/role mapping and API key naming convention.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Jen Park <jen.park@heliomed.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliomed.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-03-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff

Thanks Karthik — I'll own scheduling and the handoff. Jen/Samir: I can do a 30-minute kickoff tomorrow (3/23) at 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT; which works?

On the call we'll cover: tenant naming, project creation, user invites, API key policies (rotation + scopes), SSO expectations, and whether you want logging to go to your Splunk/Datadog instance. Rishi: please bring the minimal steps needed for integrating the SDK and the exact API key scopes.

I've attached our onboarding checklist (short) and a SAML notes PDF that lists the metadata fields we need from HelioMed.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (14KB), SSO_and_SAML_Notes.pdf (92KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Jen Park <jen.park@heliomed.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T13:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff

Quick technical notes ahead of the call —
- Tenant: we'll create "heliomed-prod-sandbox" and a default project "integration-test". Projects map to billing buckets; let us know if you want separate projects for ingestion jobs.
- API keys: we'll issue keys scoped to projects. Recommend: "heliomed-dev-key" (no write to production models) and "heliomed-ingest-key" (restricted to embeddings endpoint + ingestion queues). Keys are defaulted to 90-day rotation; we can set to 365 days if you prefer.
- Roles: Admin (full console + invite), Developer (API & console deploy), Viewer (read-only). We can also create a service account for CI with limited scopes.
- SSO: Azure AD SAML is supported. We'll need: the SAML metadata XML, Entity ID, Assertion Consumer URL, and SP-initiated/IdP-initiated preference. If HelioMed needs Just-In-Time provisioning, we support SCIM (extra setup).

I'll prepare a short runbook (3 steps) to create the tenant & keys during the call so we can do it live and hand over invites.

—Rishi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jen Park <jen.park@heliomed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliomed.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff

Thanks all — 10:00am PT tomorrow (3/23) works for us. Our engineer who will be on the call is Amy Lin (amy.lin@heliomed.com).

On SSO: we will provide SAML metadata XML and our Azure AD admin can be on the call if needed; we do not need SCIM for now, just SAML assertions and group mapping for the Admin/Developer/Viewer roles.

For user invites: please invite Jen Park (Admin) and Samir Gupta (Developer) initially. We'll confirm the QA lead for Viewer after the integration test.

Looking forward to the run-through.

Best,
Jen
Director of Engineering, HelioMed

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jen Park <jen.park@heliomed.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@heliomed.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-24T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelioMed initial tenant setup & access handoff

Great — confirmed for tomorrow 3/23 at 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent). Quick checklist for the meeting so we can finish the tenant setup in 30 minutes: 
1) HelioMed to provide: SAML metadata XML (or IdP metadata URL) and an engineer on the call (Amy).
2) Redwood will create tenant "heliomed-prod-sandbox" and project "integration-test" live on the call.
3) API keys to be issued: "heliomed-dev-key" and "heliomed-ingest-key" (we'll create a service account key if requested).
4) User invites: Jen (Admin), Samir (Developer) — Monica will send invites during the call.
5) Follow-up: Rishi will upload the 3-step runbook to Drive and include exact API call examples for key creation and model selection.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and SSO notes again for reference and added the HubSpot deal link. If anything changes before the call reply-all and we'll update the agenda.

Thanks and see you tomorrow,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, SSO_and_SAML_Notes.pdf
